tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rta mgrin snying thig snying po don sbyor las/ zab lam smin byed rnam bzhi ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga bklag chog tu bkod pa dbang chen rol pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang dpal pad+ma dbang chen gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i gangs ri las// zab mo dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun 'beb pa yis// skal ldan zhing sa smin mdzad bla ma dang*// rta mchog he ru ka la gus phyag 'tshal// snying po'i don la sbyor ba'i lam// sgom pa'i skal ldan sgo gsum rgyud// smin byed rgyud lung ma 'khrul ba// tshig sbyor spangs nas khyer bder bkod// rta mgrin snying po don sbyor gyi rtsa ba'i dbang bskur chen mo ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas lding gshar ram mgyogs dbang du bskur ba'i tshul la gsum/ sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi las rim mo// dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla slob kyi rten 'brel 'grigs pa'i tshe snyan gsan gyi gsol ba btab cing bsnyen pa kha gso ba dang*/ sgrub gnas gsar pa la sa slong ba/ sbyong srung bzung ba'i cho ga rnams gzhung ltar dgos kyang skabs 'dir mi 'grub pa'am sgrub gnas rnying pa la sa chog mi dgos pa'i dbang du byas nas sngon 'gro sta gon gyi rim pa la bzhi/ bdag bskyed/ bum pa/ lha/ slob ma sta gon no// dang po ni/ sman raka gtor gsum mchod pa'i yo byad bshams la/ sngon gtor dkar bgegs gtang ba nas brtsam/ las byang mthar chags su gtang ba las/ bdag bskyed kyi rjes su spyan 'dren la 'jug pa las mdun bskyed mi dgos shing*/ bzlas pa ci 'grub thun mtshams gtor 'bul gyi bar du bya'o// gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa lha grangs gsungs kyang bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir gtso bum mgul chings dmar po dang*/ las bum dkar po can bum mtshan dang bcas pa las sngags brjod cing gu gul bdug /spos kyis bsang*/ so lnga'i rdzas dang dri'i chus bkang*/ kha rgyan gzungs thag dang bcas me tog gi tshom bu dang ku sha'i stegs la bzhag /mchod pa bshams la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las:

rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bu: dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐: zhes byin brlab/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ yig yongs gyur pa// rin chen bum pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs// nang ni thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang*// de dbus pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud bcas// sogs mngon rtogs ltar la/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor bzhugs// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ las bum nang du pad+ma zla ba'i steng*// hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ mtshan 'od zer 'phros// 'phags mchod sems can don byas tshur 'dus pas// rdo rje sems dpa' dkar gsal rdor dril bsnams// snyems ma yum 'khril dar dang rin chen brgyan// sems skyil gyis bzhugs snang stong 'od lnga 'phro// oṃ badz+ra gu ru sogs las byang ltar spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dbang bskur gyi 'phros su/ hūm̐: bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs la: zhes kha bsgyur te/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dang*/ gong gi phyag 'tshal 'dir blangs te bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ gzungs thag la 'khril nas song*/ lha so so'i thugs kar phog /yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la/ rnam bum du/ hrīḥm ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pa dang*/ las bum du yig brgya ci 'grub bzla/ mthar lha tshogs rnams 'od du mer gyis zhu bas bum pa'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces mos/ gsum pa lha sta gon ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du dri'i thig le gtso 'khor dgu /de rgyab brgyad rim gnyis bkod pa'i steng du lha'i sa bon brjod la me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mchod gtor bshams la byin brlab gong bzhin bya/ las byang gi mdun bskyed nas brtsam bstod pa'i bar tshang bar gtang ba'am/ mchod bstod sogs mdor bsdu na bum bskyed skabs ltar byas la/

gsol ba gdab pa ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ ho: dgongs su gsol: rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum 'khor dang bcas: sems dpa' sems ma ma lus bdag la dgongs: rgyal ba sras bcas mchod pa dang: slob bu khyed kyi rjes 'jug phyir: bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa yis: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya: khyed kyi thugs rjes brtser dgongs la: byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol: ces brjod/ oṃ badz+ra ut+tiṣ+ṭha zhes pa'i sngags rgyas sta gon gyi lha steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos/ grub na skabs 'dir zhi ba'i sreg blugs bya/ mi 'grub na rdzas gcig la brten nas sdig pa sbyong ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o// bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ rdzas bzhi sogs 'du byas la/ slob ma rnams phyi rol du khrus bya/ chos bshad spyi 'gros mtshams sbyar nas/ sngon 'gro sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te zhing khams 'bul du gzhug / thog mar mya ngan 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa ni 'di la gsan par zhu/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang: dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya: gang dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer: dad pa chen po ldan pa yi: blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ba: tshe 'di'i 'bras bu gnyer mi bya: gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na: pha rol rnams kyi don mi 'grub: 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer gang: 'di 'bras 'bad pa med par 'grub: snyim pa me tog gis bkang pa'i thal mo sbyar ba dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa po: slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol: byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa: mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te: skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol: thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu: mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal: lan gsum/ rtog pa ma lus legs par bsdus nas ni:

shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon: brjed ngas blo la he ru ka sogs pa'i: bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob: ces gsungs pa yin pas yid gzhan du ma yengs par nyan par gdams pa'i tshig 'di rnams la snyan gtod 'tshal/ bu tshur theg pa chen po pa: khyod ni tshul chen snod yin pas: gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni: khyod la yang dag bstan par bya: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang dag dang: 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi: 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams: de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi: cho ga zab mo 'di mkhyen pas: dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du: thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes: gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med pa: skyob pa sangs rgyas he ru kas: bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i: dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom: thams cad kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig: de nas dbang gi ye shes bskyed pa la rgyud ma dag na snod du mi 'gyur bas theg pa thun mong gi gzhung lam gsag sbyong gis snod rung du bsgrub pa la/ bla ma dang mdun gyi nam mkhar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskor te bzhugs pa'i drung du bdun rnam dag sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: sogs lan gsum/ so shing gi ra ba tshom bu bcas bkod/ sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i so shing 'di nyid thal sbyar gyi bar du zungs la so la drud pa'i tshul byas pas sdig sgrib thams cad skyugs par mos la tshom bu'i khar 'dor bzhin du sngags 'di gsung bar zhu/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa hā: zhes 'dor du gzhug / rtse mo phyogs bzhir bstan na phrin las bzhi/ steng du mkha' spyod/ mtshams rnams su dngos grub phra mo rnams 'grub pa'i ltas su shes par gyis shig / skud pa dmar po sum bsgril mdud pa sum ldan snying pos bsngags la/

rdo rje'i mdud pa dang sngags kyis btab pa'i srad bu 'di nyid skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas su bcings pas bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las bsrung bar mos shig /oṃ bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbā na swā hā: zhes bcings/ dung zhal du las bum gyi chu bsres pa sbyin la/ baṃ las skyes pa'i dung chus kha lan gsum bshal bas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag par mos/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharma pā paṃ nish+tsa saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpā na a pā na ya hūm̐: ku sha'i phon po che chung lag g.yas g.yon du sbyin la/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rtswa mchog ku sha sngas dang stan gyi don du zungs shig /oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa hūm̐: zab mo'i chos bshad pa ni rgyud las gsungs pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ 'jig rten na ni kun mkhyen dag: u dum+ba ra'i me tog bzhin: brgya lam la ni res 'ga' zhig: 'byung bar 'gyur ram mi 'byung 'gyur: gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba: de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste: gang gi mnyam med sems can don: mya ngan mi 'da' byed par 'gyur: bskal pa bye ba du ma ru: sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang: de yis dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba: mthong bas byang bar 'gyur lags na: grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i: tshul la gnas pa smos ci dgos: skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni: go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur: gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la: blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na: de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyu: sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad: bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kun: rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed: gang phyir rgyal ba sras dang bcas: bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni: bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun: yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par: de phyir khyed rnams theg chen lam: sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur: theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i: lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan:

khyed rnams 'dir ni dang bas na: rang byung skal pa chen po pa: 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi: de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu 'gyur: las bum gyi chu 'thor la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐: zhes pas bsrung*/ de dag gis slob ma sta gon gyi rim pa rnams grub pa lags so// zhes dge bsngo byas la 'tshogs gyes so// dngos sta zhag gis bar du bcad na 'dir srung ma'i gtor 'bul/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang dge bsngo bkra shis bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi/ dbang gi yo byad bsham pa/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ bdag nyid 'jug pa/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ rten bkram zhing gnas khang rgyan gyis spras pa'i gung du stegs bu la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram pa'i dbus su rkang gsum steng rnam bum/ shar du ming dbang phreng ba/ lhor dbu rgyan dang mngar gsum chos sman sbyar ba'i thod chang*/ nub tu rdo rje dang rig tsaka /byang du dril bu dang 'ja' shel rma bya/ mdun du sman raka gtor gsum/ chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yas skor du bsham/ gzhan yang sngon gtor/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul/ chad brtan rnams dang*/ mig dar me tog /dung zhal dri bzang gi chab sogs 'og tu mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub mchod ni/ brgyud 'debs dang*/ sngon gtor nas brtsam ste las byang nyid mthar chags su btang zhing bdag mdun bskyed bzlas gtor 'bul bcas/ srung ma spyi dang khyad par gter srung spyang zhon mar gtor ma 'bul/ tshogs byin brlab nas bsgral bstab kyi bar du bya'o// gsum pa bdag 'jug ni/ rgyas par spro na dbang gi cho ga tshang bas bdag 'jug blang*/ mi 'grub na rig pa'i me tog dor ba'am/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi gcig rdzogs su blangs la bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ oṃ: nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir: thog ma tha ma med pa'i chos: sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin:

he ru ka dpal bdag sgrubs mdzod: kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste: dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha: rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal: mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrub mdzod: nyon mongs ma mchis rtag pa'i sa: 'dod chags chen po rjes chags pa: 'dod chags chen po dga' bas dga': bcom ldan der bdag grub par mdzod: dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog: dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog: grub pa'i rdo rje cher ston pa'i: rdo rje snyems mar bdag sgrub mdzod: sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing: sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs: sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid: 'dod chags dam tshig mchog gyur pa'i: bden pa gang dag ye shes mchog: shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi: bden pa de yis mgon bdag la: khyod kyis 'dod pa yongs rdzogs mdzod: chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste: gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med: bzung du med cing brjod du med: rgyu dang las las kun kyang 'byung: de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes: bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du: gzugs brnyan gsol bar slob ma rnams: kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog: ces brjod la dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgrib bo// bzhi pa dbang skur ba la gnyis/ 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ dbang dngos so// dang po slob ma rnams sgo'i phyi rol du khrus nas dbyung*/ nang du 'khod de me tog bkye bsdu byas/ sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de'ang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing khams kun tu mtshan tsam yang 'byon par dka' ba/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa thams cad kyi yang snying gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsar rnying gi ring lugs rnams las/ gsung mchog rta mgrin dbang chen gyi rgyud dang*/ de'i man ngag gsung gi rig 'dzin 'phags pa klu sgrub/ mi tra dzo ki /o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po la sogs pas gdams pa'i bka' srol mtha' yas pa zhig mchis pa las skabs su babs pa/

zab lam rdo rje snying po/ rdzogs chen rta mgrin snying thig /man ngag snying po don gyi sbyor ba zhes bya ba rdzogs chen yang gsang gnad gyi gdams skor dbang chen rta mchog gi bskyed rim dang 'brel ba'i zab chos khyad par du 'phags pa 'di ni/ mkha' klong rnam par dag pa 'og min chos kyi dbyings 'od kyis khengs par gdod ma'i mgon po bum pa sku ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub par 'od gsal ba'i dgongs par bzhugs pa las/ brtse ba'i thugs rjes longs sku rdo rje 'chang zhal phyag mtshan dpe'i rnam par bzhengs te sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nas/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la mnyam nyid klong rdol gyi dgongs pa rang bzhin gyi rlabs kyis bshad/ des dur khrod me ri 'bar bar bzhugs pa mi yul du bzhugs kyang dgongs pa sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa sprul pa po dga' rab rdo rje la brda tsam tshig tsam du bshad/ des dur khrod chen po siṅga la ru sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+mā ka ra la mngon sum rang thog tu phab nas bshad/ de nyid lho nub srin po'i kha gnon du gshegs par nye ba na bsam yas dbu rtse chen mor mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje ye shes mtsho rgyal dang*/ dbang chen rta mgrin gyi sprul pa chos blo mgon po gnyis la gnas lugs yid dpyod dang phral/ lnga ldan ye shes snying po mngon sum gtan la phab nas bstan te/ ji skad du/ e ma bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas nga: sngon gyi las 'phros bod kyi yul du mchis: rgyal po khri srong lde btsan bsam pa bsgrubs: bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag bzhengs: dam pa'i chos kyi bstan pa rgyas par byas: phyi rabs don du gter kha bye ba sbas: zab lam yang bcud snying po don sbyor 'di: gdams pa kun gyi nang nas kyang: mthar thug yang bcud min re kan: ma 'ongs don du rin chen gter du sbos: lan gcig dus kyi tha mar gyur pa'i tshe: rta mgrin sprul pa rdzu 'phrul can:

nges med spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa: las can chos blo mgon dang 'di 'phrad shog: ces gdams pa ltar/ mkhar chen bzas bka'i bsdu ba mdzad de ma 'ongs las 'phro can gyi thugs su brgyud par byin gyis brlabs nas shog ser g.yu'i sgrom bur rgyas btab ste/ nyang po rgya shod brag dkar lha chur gter kha chen po lnga'i gtso bor sbas shing ḍā ki sngags kyi srung ma dang nyang po'i lha btsan spun dgu la gnyer du gtad pa/ nam zhig dus la bab pa'i tshe chos blo ar+ya sā le'i skye mtha'/ dka' thub kyi sgrub pa mthar phyin pas 'byung ba bzhi la dbang sgyur ba'i grub thob chen po mchog ldan rdo rje'am/ las rab zhig po gling pas spyan drangs shing*/ phyis su de nyid kyi yang srid rtsod pa dang bral ba'i gter chen stag sham bsam gtan gling pas chos kyi bdag po'i tshul gyis khyab brdal du spel bar mdzad pa 'di la smin byed kyi dbang bskur rgyas bsdus gnyis su bzhugs pa las/ rgyas pa dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs su bsgrub par bgyi ba la bdag nyid kyi bgyi ba'i rim pa thams cad grub zin pa lags pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis bgyi 'os thog mar dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te zhing khams 'bul ba zhu/

zhes brjod la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug / slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la mos gus drag pos thal mo me tog dang bcas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ e ma hoḥsangs rgyas slob dpon che: e ma hoḥchos dang tshogs kyi mchog: e ma hoḥbacom ldan dbang chen he ru ka: phag mo yum dang yang dag sbyor: dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa po: sogs gong ltar gyis gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i khro chung mtshon cha me'i tshwa tshwas bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad par gyur/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang yungs dkar gu gul rol mo'i sgras bgegs bskrad/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas bdun rnam dag lan gsum sta gon skabs ltar bya/ zhing mchog de dag gi spyan sngar rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang: dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun: thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis: dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su: ji srid snying po byang chub bar: ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams: byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i: byang chub sems ni bla na med: dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang: dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang: sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum: so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te: bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum: sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i: sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung: rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la: rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang: yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi: slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi: rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi: dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la:

nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu: zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams: sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin: byang chub chen po las byung ba: pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la: phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum: dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi: las kyi rigs mchog chen po la: sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni: yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi: mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi: byang chub sems ni bla na med: dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir: bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung: ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang: ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang: dbugs ma dbyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing: 'gro kun mya ngan 'das la 'god: lan gsum/ sngon chad dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du ma zhugs pa'am ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bcas pa mtshon byed du oṃ las byung ba'i dar dmar pos gdong bkab par mos/ oṃ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐: zhes gdong bcing*/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i me tog phyag tu gtad par mos/ u dum+ba ra man+dā ra: yongs 'du dang ni mal+li ka: ka ra bī ra'i me tog 'di: legs par nos la bus zungs shig: ces me tog gtad/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri bzang po'i chus gnas gsum du thig le bya zhing*/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa: mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa: snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa re sgom mdzod: gnas gsum du mar la reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: yar la reg cing*/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ: brjod/ de nas skal pa dang ldan nam mi ldan brtag pa ni/ bu khyod su yin: ces dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos/ bdag skal pa bzang po'o: khyod ci la dga': zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos/ bde ba chen po la'o: des bu la ci zhig bya: zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos/ dbang chen yab yum gyi dam tshig go: de nas slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje bzung la/

khyed rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa re sgoms la rjes zlos/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pād ya mi: gsum/ rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa bzhag la/ sems bskyed pa de brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho: sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ: rdo rje spyi bor bzung nas/ dus 'di nas ni khyod nyid ni: sangs rgyas rigs su chud pas na: nga yis rdo rje ye shes sbyin: des ni sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur: gang zhig 'di ni ma mthong ba'i: mdun du smra bar mi bya ste: bag med smras na nyams par 'gyur: zhes gsang bar gdams/ bgegs mthar byed kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo rnams phyes te nang du khrid par mos shig /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: yol ba bsal/ shar nas phyogs bzhi rim par lha snam la 'khod de dkyil 'khor pa'i sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal bar mos la thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pa s+thā na ya āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi: sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ: zhes pas gtso bo dang*/ shar phyogs pa la byin rlabs zhu bar mos mdzod/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣiñtsa āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi: sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ: lho phyogs pa la dbang zhu bar mos mdzod/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra warta na ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi: sarba swasti sarba dharma pra warta yā mī: nub phyogs su chos bzung bar mos mdzod/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā karmā ṇi āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi: sarba ta thā ga ta sarba karma ku ru māṃ: byang phyogs su phrin las sgrub par mos mdzod/ slar shar gyi lha snam du 'khod pa la ye shes pa dbab pa'i sngon 'gro dam bzhag bzhi po bya ba yin pas snyan gtod par zhu/

spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na: dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos: de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes nga yis khyod la bskyed par bya yis: khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste: smras na bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re: zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag /rdo rje snying gar bzung nas/ he ru ka dpal yab yum deng khyod kyi: snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur: nga yis bstan pa'i gsang ba 'di: dam tshig med pa'i mi rnams dang: gang yang 'ga' la smras gyur na: de ma thag tu dral te gshegs: zhes nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag /de nas las thams cad pa'i chu blud la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu: dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed: dam tshig srung na dngos grub ni: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub: oṃ pañtsa a mṛta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha: mna' chu'i sgo nas dam la bzhag /mgo bor rdo rje bzung la/ de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyi: yi dam dbang chen nga yin gyis: nga yis ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: khyod kyis skyo ba med par sgrubs: gang yang nga la brnyas pa min: de bzhin mos par ma byas na: bdud kyis bcom ste dmyal bar 'gro: de bas dam tshig thub par srungs: zhes bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag go / de nas ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma he ru ka dang bcas pa la gsol ba 'debs so: dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig: bdag la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ye shes phob cig: lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams lus thang sha bcad/ thal mo spyi bor bzhag la dmigs pa 'di ma yengs par gyis shig /khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug tsam phyi dkar la nang dmar ba:

de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo: spyi bor rtsa 'dab ma sum cu so gnyis kyi lte bar haṃ yig dkar po: mgrin par rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte bar oṃ yig dkar po: snying gar rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po: lte bar rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar āḥyig dmar po: lte ba'i āḥlas ye shes kyi me 'bar bas: snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ bsreg /de spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung nas: lus thams cad zag med kyi bde bas khyab par mos: gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dbang chen yab yum gyi rnam par lus la sib sib thim pas lus thams cad bde mer mer byung bar mos mdzod: rol mo dang ye shes 'beb pa'i sbyar spos bdug la/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta h+ya grī ba badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a a āḥhrīḥbaṃ swā hā: zhes drag tu brjod pas: sku la babs na 'phar: gsung la babs na sngags: thugs la babs na mi rtog pa skye bar 'gyur ro: de nas dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i phyir bden pa brjod pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas: bcom ldan dbang chen yab yum gyi: snying po'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir: bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi: lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa bzhin: dkyil 'khor 'dir yang de bzhin shog: 'dir ni dngos grub gang 'grub dang: rigs ni gang gi snod dang ldan: bsod nams rim pa de bzhin shog: ces brjod do: de nas me tog phul ba'i slad du pho brang 'di'i dbus na bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin yab yum gyi lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i dbu la sngar byin pa'i me tog gi phreng ba phul bar mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho: me tog slob dpon gyis blangs la/ zhes phul ba de nyid gtso bo'i dbu la phog pa slar yang khyed rang gi spyi bor bcings par mos shig

/sems dpa' stobs chen khyed kyis ni: 'di ni rtag tu bcang bar gyis: oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa i maṃ satwa ma hā bā la: zhes me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag /rdo rje'i mig thur thogs la/ slob ma'i ma rig pa'i mig phyes nas ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan par bsam la: bcom ldan dpa' bo chen po deng khyod kyi: mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad: phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur: rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med: oṃ nai tra a pa hā ra pa ta laṃ hri: zhes pas gdong g.yogs phyes la lha ngo bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos: da ni dad pa rab tu skyed: khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes: dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa kun: thams cad khyod kyis mngon du 'gyur: sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs: dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang: sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis: spro na skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor rnam dag gter gzhung ltar bshad/ bsdu na/ rang snang ye shes las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang rgyan dang bkod pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi rol dur khrod brgyad srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad dang nyi zla la sogs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ gtso po rta mgrin dbang chen yum rdo rje phag mo dang gnyis su med par 'khril ba/ phyogs bzhir dbang chen rigs bzhi/ mtshams bzhir dpa' bo sde bzhi rnams rang rang gi yum dang bcas pa/ sgo bzhir gdong can ma bzhi/ mtshams bzhir phyed gzugs ma bzhi ste dpal dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor pa/ gzhi'i chos rnam par dag pa lam dang 'bras bu'i ye shes kyi brda rtags rnam par shar ba rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar mos la dad pa dang spro ba bskyed de phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi: dkyil 'khor bdag gis de ring mthong:

rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi: dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi: dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang skur: de dag rnams kyis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub pa yin no// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba dngos la bzhi/ bum pa/ gsang ba/ sher ye/ dbang bzhi pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang*/ slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// dang po ni/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ ji ltar rdo rje 'chang chen pos: rdo rje sems dpar dbang bskur ltar: de bzhin bdag la dbang bskur ba'i: don mchog dam pa bstsal du gsol: lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis dril bu 'khrol cing dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa ni: rdo rje 'chang gis 'gro bskyab phyir: yon tan 'byung gnas byin pa ltar: de bzhin slob ma 'di dag la: dbang bskur dam pa gnang bar mdzod: zhes dkyil 'khor la mkhyen par gsol ba gdab nas gnang ba byin par bsam la: khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs rin po che'i khri'i steng du bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dbang chen sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur pa'i steng du gdugs: phyogs mtshams rnams su mchod tshogs du mas bskor bar mos shig: bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs par gyur: badz+ra sa mā dza: sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis de dag la mchod par gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs brjod/ de nas khyad par gyi gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la: mchod cing ji ltar gsol ba ltar: bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir: nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol: lan gsum/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad:

yum lngas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod: lha mo rnams kyis mchod: rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len: khro bo rnams kyis oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod cing bgegs bskrad pa sogs bkra shis kyi rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas dbang bskur ba'i phrin las mdzad par gyur: las rdor gyis bum pa btegs/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril bcas me tog 'thor la/ mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi sogs bkra shis brjod cing rol mo bya/ de nas las bum gyi chu dang*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pas bsang*/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas bum pa'i chu stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las: gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa: yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par ā: thugs kar hūm̐: hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum kyi rnam par badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: gnyis ka la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐: zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur: dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan: yab yum snyoms par zhugs rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ba las bum pa'i chur gyur: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma la mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur bar gyur:

sangs rgyas kun gyi chu yi dbang: de ring khyod la sbyin par bya: sangs rgyas kun tu bsgrub pa'i phyir: chu yi dbang 'di blang bar gyis: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang: sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa la: bla ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par mos mdzod: ar+ghaṃ

nas shab+da āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod/ des mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang bskur ba thob: nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dag: rnam shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur: me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no: dbu rgyan bsang sbyang*/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āṃ las rin po che āṃ gis mtshan pa las: gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa: yum sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par ā: thugs kar hūm̐: hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rin 'byung yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: gnyis ka la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐: zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur: dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan: yab yum snyoms par zhugs rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ba las rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma la rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbang bskur du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas dbu rgyan thogs nas dbang bskur bar gyur: sangs rgyas kun gyi dbu rgyan dbang: de ring khyod la bskur bar bya: sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir: cod pan rin chen dam pa 'dis: 'khor los bsgyur rgyal mchog dbang bskur: āṃḥlāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ rat+na mu kuṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: zhes dbu rgyan bkon/ slar bum chus dbang bskur te/ bum pa'i dbang bskur chen po mchog: khams gsum po yis phyag byas pa'i:

gsang ba gsum ni 'byung ba'i gnas: sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya: a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ: de ltar bum pa'i chu'i dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan pa la: bla ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par mos mdzod: ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐: des rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba thob: nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna dag: tshor ba'i phung po gnas 'gyur: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no: rdo rje bsang sbyang*/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas rdo rje stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa las: gnyis ka'ang snang ba mtha' yas dmar po pad+ma dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa: yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par ā: thugs kar hūm̐: hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: gnyis ka la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐: zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur: dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan: yab yum snyoms par zhugs rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ba las rdo rjer gyur: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma la snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje'i dbang bskur du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas rdo rje thogs nas dbang bskur bar gyur: sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang:

de ring khyod la bskur bar bya: sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir: rdo rje'i dbang 'di khyed kyis longs: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shūn+ya tā badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: zhes rdo rje lag g.yas su gtad/ slar yang*/ bum pa'i dbang bskur sogs gong bzhin brjod la chu dbang bskur/ de ltar bum pa'i chu'i dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa la: bla ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par mos mdzod: ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod/ des snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba thob: nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag: 'du shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur: so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no: dril bu bsang sbyang*/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas dril bu stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las: gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa: yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par ā: thugs kar hūm̐: hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad don yod grub pa yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: gnyis ka la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐: zhes gsung zhing dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur: dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan: yab yum snyoms par zhugs rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ba las dril bur gyur:

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma la don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang bskur du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas dril bu thogs nas dbang bskur bar gyur: sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang: de ring khyod la bskur bar bya: chos kyi dril bu bla na med: stong nyid ye shes sgra sgrog pa: thams cad stong nyid don rtogs pa'i: dril bu'i dbang 'di blang bar gyis: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shab+da la ye dharma dhā tu a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye hūm̐: zhes dril bu lag g.yon du gtad/ slar yang*/ bum pa'i dbang bskur sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan pa la: bla ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par mos mdzod: ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod/ des don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang bskur ba thob: nyon mongs pa phrag dog dag: 'du byed kyi phung po gnas 'gyur: bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no: slob ma bsang sbyang*/ slob ma mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las: khyed rang rnams rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa: yum dbyings phyug ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par ā: thugs kar hūm̐: hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rnam snang yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: slob ma la gnyis su med par gyur: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma la rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang bskur du gsol:

zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas me tog gi phreng ba spyi bor bcings te rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bar gyur: phreng ba spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang: de ring khyod la bskur bar bya: sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir: rdo rje'i ming dbang khyod kyis longs: oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣe ka ta shrī sa ma ye hūm̐: kye dpal dbang chen dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// 'dir dpe mtshon pa ste gsang mtshan 'os mthun slob ma so sor sbyar/ slar/ bum pa'i dbang bskur sogs kyis chu dbang dang*/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan pa la: bla ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par mos mdzod: ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod/ des rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang bskur ba thob: nyon mongs pa gti mug dag: gzugs kyi phung po gnas 'gyur: chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no: de dag gis phung po lnga dang nyon mongs pa ye shes lngar gnas gyur pas: rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur pas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya ba'o: rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du khyed rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las: rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa: yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros pas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: slob ma la gnyis su med par gyur: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma la rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur du gsol:

zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis rdo rje lag g.yas su gtad par gyur: slob dpon gyis rdo rje g.yas su sbyin la gsor du gzhug cing*/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na bsnams: khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs: rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan: ma hā badz+ra hūm̐: khyed rang rnams kyi snying gi nang du rdo rje sems dpa' sgom pa dang ma bral bar mdzod cig: des tha mal pa'i spyod pa brtul zhing rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs la zhugs pa ste slob ma'i dbang rnams rdzogs pa yin no: gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye hoḥkhyed kyi bka' drin gyis: bdag la rang dang gzhan gyi don: rdzogs phyir rdo rje slob dpon dbang: snying rje'i gter gyis bstsal du gsol: lan gsum/ slob ma'i lus rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa stong pa'i ngang las: rin po che'i pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du: khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams nas yum phag mo mthing ga gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can: phyogs mtshams rnams su mchod tshogs du mas bskor ba'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros pas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: slob ma dang gnyis su med par gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma la rdo rje 'chang gi rang bzhin rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas: dbang gi lha rnams kyis:

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bo hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i dam tshig gnang bar mos mdzod: rdo rje g.yas su gtad la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: bcom ldan he ru ka'i phyag na bsnams: khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i brtul zhugs brtan: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: oṃ badz+ra dha ra pad+mān+ta kṛta h+ya grī ba badz+ra bā ra hī hi hī hūm̐: rdo rje snying gar gsor la de kho na nyid kyi don dran par gyis shig: thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni: rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che: kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid: rdo rje sems dpa' kun gyi bdag: bcom ldan dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o: oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐: zhes pas thugs rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs par mos shig: slar yang dbang lha rnams kyis: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsung gi ngo bo a las byung ba'i dril bu'i dam tshig gnang bar mos: dril bu lag g.yon du gtad la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad: khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang: byang chub mchog dbang rgyal bas bzhed: a: dril bu dkrol zhing dku g.yon du brten la de kho na nyid dran par gyis shig: srid pa ngo bo nyid dag pa: ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas: rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa: srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ā: zhes pas gsung rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs par mos shig: slar yang dbang lha rnams kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo phyag rgya'i dam tshig bstsal bar mos shig: rdor dril 'khyud tshul byar gzhug la/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che: zungs shig rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs: de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur: slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis: srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung: sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir:

shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs: dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu zungs: 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la: ci 'dod par ni spyad bzhin du: rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor ba: bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis: 'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa: phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su grags: oṃ ma hā mu dra badz+ra sa ma ya oṃ: zhes pas sku rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs shing rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi bdag nyid rdo rje slob dpon chen por gyur pa la dbang lha rnams kyis bum pas dbang bskur bar mos shig: rnam bum thogs la/ bum pa'i dbang bskur chen po mchog: khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa: gsang ba gsum ni 'byung ba'i gnas: sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya: a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ: zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur: byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod: mchod pa'i lha mos mchod: rig mas rdo rje'i glu blang: khro bos bgegs bskrad cing dbang bskur bar mos shig: de ltar dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun des spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad gang: dri ma thams cad dag: chu lhag ma yar lud pa la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa la: bla ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐: nam mkha' bzhugs pa'i dbang lha rnams kyis rab tu gnas shing khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā:

zhes me tog 'thor zhing rol mo ldir/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang khyed rang la thim pas gnyis su med par mos mdzod/ ࿋ mtha' rten du brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rjes su gnang ba yin te/ de nyid rig pa'i rgyal po la: mi bya ba ni cung zad med: de nyid shes na nges par ni: bde stong dbyer ni med pa nyid: rig pa 'dod yon lnga la spyod: dpa' bos 'dod pa lnga la spyod: de nas lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba yin te/ bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi dngos: de phyir bdag nyid thams cad bya: bdag nyid he ru ka dpal mchod: de nas sems can gyi don byed par rjes su gnang ba yin te/ rten cing 'brel 'byung chos can dang: sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no: khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni: sems can don ni mnyam med byos: snod bcud thams cad sgyu ma ltar: shes par gyis la sems can gyi don rgya chen po gyis shig: de nas rtogs pa bskyed cing gzengs bstod pa 'di la gsan par zhu/ de ring khyod bdag legs par rnyed: mi yi srid pa don dang bcas: sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su skyes: sems nyid rin chen 'byung ba'i gter: phun sum tshogs la nye bar gnas: gsang sngags mnyam med sems la grub: zag med bde ba'i dkyil 'khor che: mthong ba dang ni zhugs gyur pas: sdig pa kun las rnam par grol: byang chub spyod mchog rmad byung brnyes: sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir: bdud bzhi 'joms shing sdug bsngal gyi: skye rga na 'chi 'jig par byed: srid pa ngo bo nyid dag pa: dbang chen he ru ka dpal da gyur to: de ltar na ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du phyi spros bcas bum pa'i dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pa thob: lus kyi dri ma dag: lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang: 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'o: zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/

mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya rgyan gyis spras pa phul bar mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ma khyed ni bde ba che: bde chen pad+ma he ru ka: bde gshegs rnams kyi bde chen lam: bde ba'i dbang phyug bde stsol mdzod: byang chub sems ni yang dag don: rnam dag mchog gis yang dag pa'i: dri med bdud rtsi dam pa yi: bla med mchog gis dbang bskur ltar: de bzhin rigs kyi bu bdag la: 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kun bsal mdzod: dri med bde chen bdud rtsi yis: ma rig nyes pa'i dri ma choms: bla med byang chub bde chen nyid: dus 'dir bdag gis thob mdzod cig: slar yang nan tan du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la: mchod chen ji ltar bstsal pa ltar: bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir: gsang ba'i dbang mchog gnang bar mdzod: lan gsum/ oṃ tsak+ṣuḥban+dha bā ra mā ṇa ye swā hā: zhes pas 1$0000250spyan dar 'ching*/ 1$0000300skad cig gis slob dpon nyid dpal chen po rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa: yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams pa: yab yum gnyis snyoms 'jug mdzad pa'i dga' ba'i sgra chen pos dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams spyan drangs te: dpa' bo rnams yab kyi zhal du zhugs: dpa' mo rnams yum gyi zhal du zhugs: thugs kar 'od du zhu: sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas dpa' bo thams cad 'dus pa'i byang sems dkar po dang: dpa' mo thams cad 'dus pa'i byang sems dmar po gnyis 'dres pas kun rdzob byang chub sems su gyur pa de nyid khyed rang rnams la byin pas gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos shig: byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod mtheb srin gyis bzung la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis: byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar:

bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni: sems kyi rgyud kyis dbang bskur ro: zhes bdud rtsi lce thog bzhag / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las sku gnyis pa 'phros: de nyid snang ba mtha' yas su gyur nas khyed rang gi mgrin par thim pas: rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags nas rang byung gi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa la mchod par mos shig: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs brjod/ 'bru gsum gyis 1$0000250gdong g.yogs bsal/ 1$0000300de ltar bla ma yab yum gyi lus dkyil la brten nas nang spros med gsang ba'i dbang bskur pa thob: ngag gi dri ma dag: mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim rtsa dang rlung bsgom pa la dbang: 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'o: gsum pa sher ye ni/ de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye: rnam dag rdo rje mi phyed bdag: yang dag phyag rgya sgrub pa pos: rdo rje rnal 'byor las ni byung: ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che: mnga' bdag bdag la de ltar mdzod: 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du: bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs: lan gsum/ sngar ltar sngags brjod la gdong g.yogs/ las sngags dang bum chu 'thor la bsang zhing bsrung*/ rig tsaka gtad la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bo khyed rang la gtad par mos shig: lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che: mtha' yas bde ba ster ba mo: rnam pa kun tu phyag rgyar longs: bu yis bla med mchod par gyis: de ltar byin pa'i phyag rgyas 'di skad brjod par mos: dpa' bo byang chub sems za bar: khyod ni spro ba yin nam ci: rigs lnga las ni rang byung ba'i: rig ma mchod pa la gus sam: dri chen dri chu khrag la sogs: bza' bar da lta yid ches sam: rjes mthun 'gyur smros dam tshig khyod: ji ltar dga' bar smros shig bu:

zhes pa'i lan btab par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos: ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig sogs: lha mo bdag ni cis mi spro: bud med rtag gus cis mi byed: pad+mar mchod pa cis mi bgyi: zhes brjod pas lha mo dgyes pas skra grol zhing gos dang bral bar byas te pad+ma ston zhing: e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di: bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas: ci ste cho ga bzhin bsten na: de yi mdun du nga gnas te: sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa'i: bya ba pad+ma ci bzhin byed: bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni: 'di nyid du ni rtag tu gnas: blun po 'ga' zhig 'di spong na: de la mchog gi dngos grub med: pad+ma bhañdza mok+ṣa ho: zhes gsungs shing pang du byon par mos: khyed rang skad cig gis he ru ka sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa: yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa: gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par ā: thugs kar hūm̐: lte bar swā: brla'i bar du hās mtshan pa: bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: slob ma yab yum la thim par gyur: de nas khyed rang yab yum lhar gsal ba dang gnas lnga'i yi ge bcas snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems zhu zhing rim par babs pa: spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pas dga' ba: snying gar sleb pas mchog dga': lte bar sleb pas dga' bral: nor bu'i rtser sleb pas lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes mngon du gyur par mos la bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor mnyam par 'jog pa zhu: zhes cung zad bzhag / de nas shes rab ma de mnyes nas: mgo bor lag pa g.yon pa bzhag nas 'di skad gsung bar mos shig: deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis: ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar: smin par bya ba sems can gyi: don ni bdag nyid kun gyis shig:

ces rjes su gnang ba byin pa la: mchod pa'i bye brag gis mchod par mos: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ 'bru gsum gyis 1$0000250gdong g.yogs bsal/ 1$0000300de ltar phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur pa thob: yid kyi dri ma dag: dngos dang yid kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang: 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no: bzhi pa la gnyis/ tshig dbang spyir bstan/ rtsal dbang khyad par du bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis: gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob: de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang: bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum/ 1$0000250spyan dar 'ching*/ 1$0000300bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa las he ru ka yab yum gyi sku gnyis pa 'phros: khyed rang rnams kyi smin mtshams su thim pas lus bde stong du phril gyis song bar mos shig: ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing: rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu: rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid: khyod rang yang ni de yi pha: zhes pa'i don ni: dbang gsum pa'i dus nyams su myong ba'i don sems kyi chos nyid sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang ro gcig par lhod kyis klod la: bde stong chen po'i ngang la mnyam par zhog cig: ces re zhig bskyang du gzhug / des ka dag khregs chod lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes tshig dbang rin po che thob pa yin pas mchod par mos shig: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ 1$0000250gdong g.yogs bsal/ 1$0000300de'i dam tshig tu rnam rtog gi srog gcod pa dang: sangs rgyas kyi yon tan las ma byin par len pa dang: chos thams cad rdzun pa sgyu ma lta bur spyad pa dang: stong nyid mdzes ma'i bud med la spyad pa rnams dang du blang bar bya dgos so:

gnyis pa rtsal dbang khyad par ba ni/ de nas mngon sum rig pa'i rtsal dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'dir sman lnga 'bru lnga dri lnga rin po che lnga'i maṇ+ḍal rnams lan bdun bdun 'bul bar gsungs pas 'grub na gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye kye: bla ma rje btsun dam pa rnams kyis bdag smin par mdzad du gsol: rig pa'i rtsal dbang bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang bskur du gsol: bdag grol bar mdzad du gsol: mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bstsal du gsol: lan gsum brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams dpal rta mgrin dbang chen dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa gnas lngar dpa' bo rigs lnga bzhugs pa: yum phag mo mthing nag gri thod 'dzin pa gnas lngar mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang bcas pa 'khril sbyor du bzhugs pa'i spyi bor ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dkar po: mgrin par dmar po: snying gar sngon po: lte bar ser po: gsang bar ljang gu: thams cad kyang 'dab bzhi ye shes lnga'i mu khyud kyis bskor bas mtshan par mos la dmigs pa 'di rnams rim bzhin bsgom pa dang 'bru lnga bzla bar zhu: spyi bo'i da lar oṃ dkar bsgom: 'od 'phros rang lus oṃ du gyur: oṃ las 'od tshogs oṃ 'phros pas: snod bcud thams cad oṃ du gyur: bdag gzhan lus sgrib kun dag bsam: oṃ mang du bzlar gzhug / lus kyi dri ma kun dag nas: sangs rgyas sku yi dbang rnams thob: mgrin pa'i da lar āḥdamar bsgom: 'od 'phros rang lus āḥru gyur: āḥlas 'od tshogs āḥ'aphros pas: snang srid thams cad āḥru gyur: bdag gzhan ngag sgrib kun dag bsam: āḥ bzlar gzhug ngag gi dri ma kun dag nas: sangs rgyas gsung gi dbang rnams thob: snying ga'i da lar hūm̐ mthing bsgom: 'od 'phros rang lus hūm̐ du gyur: hūm̐ las 'od tshogs hūm̐ 'phros pas: snang srid thams cad hūm̐ du gyur: bdag gzhan yid sgrib kun dag bsam:

hūm̐ bzlar gzhug / yid kyi sgrib pa kun dag nas: sangs rgyas thugs kyi dbang rnams thob: lte ba'i da lar trāṃ ser bsgom: 'od 'phros rang lus trāṃ du gyur: trāṃ las 'od tshogs trāṃ 'phros pas: snang srid thams cad trāṃ du gyur: bdag gzhan nga rgyal kun dag bsam: trāṃ bzlar gzhug / nga rgyal sgrib pa kun dag nas: sangs rgyas yon tan dbang rnams thob: gsang ba'i da lar phaṭa ljang bsgom: 'od 'phros rang lus phaṭa tu gyur: phaṭa las 'od tshogs phaṭa 'phros pas: snang srid thams cad phaṭa tu gyur: bdag gzhan phrag dog kun dag bsam: phaṭa bzlar gzhug / phrag dog sgrib pa kun dag nas: sangs rgyas phrin las dbang rnams thob: de ltar khyad par rig pa'i rtsal dbang gis thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud smin byed du bsgrubs nas: dngos gzhi mngon sum ngo sprad pa la lus gnad tsog pur sdod: sgo'i gnad mig zlog phab zur bltas rnams dang 'brel par 'od gsal gyi snang ba mtshon par gyis shig: ces byas la nyi zer dang sbyar zhing*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i me long rma bya'i mdongs rnams kyis kyang mtshon par byas la/ 'o rigs kyi bu 'di ltar ma mthong ba mthong ba 'di rang byung gi thig le nyag cig chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba zhes bya ba yin no: sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dang zhal mngon sum du mjal ba zhes bya'o: sku gsum ye shes lnga mngon du gyur pa zhes bya'o: las dang bag chags dang sdig sgrib ma rig pa thams cad zad pa zhes bya'o: las dang skal bar ldan pa zhes bya'o: bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa zhes bya'o: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbang dus gcig tu thob pa zhes bya'o: 'od mthing ga gsal ba rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhal mthong: nyon mongs pa rnam par dag: chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du gyur: 'od dkar po gsal ba rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mthong: nyon mongs pa rnam par dag:

me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du gyur: 'od ser po gsal ba rin chen 'byung ldan gyi zhal mthong: nyon mongs pa rnam par dag: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du gyur: 'od dmar po gsal ba snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhal mthong: nyon mongs pa rnam par dag: so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur: 'od ljang gu gsal ba don yod grub pa'i zhal mthong: nyon mongs pa rnam par dag: bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur: dus de ring nas bzung ste sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po dang rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams dang khyod la spu tsam khyad par med pas: yid ches par gyis shig: ces ngo sprod gdab/ de ltar snang srid sems dang 'od gsal ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du: don dam rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob: sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi dri ma dag: lam bden gnyis zung 'jug khregs chod dang thod rgal bsgom pa la dbang: 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no: dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs mkha' khyab kyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ shis pa'i bden tshig dbyangs su len cing rin chen me tog char du bsnyil bas dbang gi ye shes bskyed pa dang brtan pa dang gong du 'phel bar byas par mos shig / rten snying dang zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad brjod la me tog 'thor ro// gsum pa rjes kyi rim la gnyis/ dbang dang dkyil 'khor rjes chog go /dang po ni/

de dag rnams kyis grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen po las rab zhig po gling pa'i zab gter rta mgrin snying po don sbyor gyi rtsa ba'i dbang bzhi rgyas pa legs par grub pa yin pas sogs kyis mtshams sbyar la/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba/ dge bsngo byas la slob ma gyes so// gnyis pa ni/ tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma gtang ba nas bkra shis brjod pa'i bar las byang ltar tshang bar btang pas grub bo// zab cing rnam dag ngo mtshar che ldan kyang*// rang gsang gter bzhin dkon pa'i snying thig 'di// ris med rnal 'byor spyod yul nyid gyur nas// smin grol snang ba nyi ltar brdal gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang sangs rgyas kun dngos o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po'i gsung rab la mchog tu gces par 'dzin pa'i mos gus lhag pa'i bsam pa lhan skyes su 'chang ba 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa rtsal gyis/ rnam 'dren dam pa byang chub chos kyi seng ges rin po che'i me tog dang bcas pa'i gsung gis bskul bas rkyen byas te/ dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du gter gzhung gi dgongs pa gsal bar phyes te go gsal du bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// //
